title: NOT TASKBASE — 2002, the domain's previous owner
notes: Not Taskbase. A curiosity: taskbase.com had an owner before us, and this is what the domain served. Taskbase the company was founded in 2015 and did not get taskbase.com until 2016 (see the 2016-01 card for the last page the old owner served). The archive holds exactly four captures of www.taskbase.com from 2001-2004 and this is the only one with real content: a staff login for some unrelated task tracker, posting to tasklogin.cfm. The other three are a GDEX Internet Services "Under Construction" placeholder (2001-02), a meta-refresh to a bare IP (2003-11), and an "off-line for maintenance" page carrying a US phone number (2004-10). Nothing archived between 2004 and 2016, so the trail from that owner to ours is blank. Renders exactly as captured, no assets to lose — the page never had any. The login form posts nowhere. A muted badge at bottom right repeats the "not Taskbase" warning for anyone who opens the page on its own.
